# Disk Explorer Professional XML report profile (`disk-explorer-xml-report`)

Read/write capability in `SkyCD.Plugin.DiskExplorer`. Discovery uses assembly
metadata and the capability type; no `plugin.json` is involved. The profile is
fully specified here so the plugin can be rebuilt without any external executable.

## File shape

XML 1.0, UTF-8, root `REPORT` with a `Title` attribute:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- Generated by Disk Explorer Professional -->
<REPORT Title="Catalog title">
  ...
</REPORT>
```

Detection requires the exact `REPORT` root plus report shape (a title or an `ITEM`
carrying `ItemType`), so unrelated `.xml` files are never claimed.

## Items

Hierarchy is recursive `ITEM` elements in document order:

```xml
<ITEM ItemType="Volume|CategoryFolder|Folder|Archive|File">
  <NAME>...</NAME>
  <FILES>...</FILES>
  <FOLDERS>...</FOLDERS>
  <SIZE>...</SIZE>
  <DATE>...</DATE>
  <TIME>...</TIME>
  <TYPE>...</TYPE>
  <DESC><![CDATA[...]]></DESC>
  <ITEM ...>...</ITEM>
</ITEM>
```

`ItemType` matches case-insensitively on import; export always writes the canonical
spelling. Mapping: `Volume` → media, `CategoryFolder`/`Folder` → folder,
`Archive`/`File` → file. Unknown `ItemType` values default to folder when the item
has children and file otherwise, and the raw value is preserved for round trips.

`NAME`, `FILES`, `FOLDERS`, `SIZE`, `DATE`, `TIME`, `TYPE`, `DESC` are optional.
`FILES`/`FOLDERS`/`SIZE` are unsigned decimal bytes/counts; invalid numbers abort
the import with a typed diagnostic. `DATE`/`TIME` stay verbatim display fields
plus normalized ISO copies when they parse (`DateNormalized`, `TimeNormalized`);
unparseable values are kept as-is, never silently changed. `TYPE` becomes
`FormatType`, `DESC` becomes `Description` (CDATA or plain text alike).

Unknown elements and attributes are retained as `DiskExplorer.<el>` /
`DiskExplorer.ITEM.<attr>` extension properties and reported once in the summary.
Thumbnail-ish elements (`Thumbnail`, `Preview`, `CoverArt`, ...) are presence
markers only (`HasThumbnail`); payload bytes are never retained. The original
`ItemType` spelling round-trips through `ExportItemType`.

Empty `ITEM` elements without fields are skipped with a reason; a report with no
items fails as empty; non-`REPORT` roots fail as unsupported schema.

## Safety bounds

Parsing uses hardened `XmlReader` settings (no DTD, no resolvers), a 256-level
depth cap, a 1,000,000-item cap and a 256 MiB document cap, with cancellation
honored while reading. DTD/XXE content is rejected at the recognition gate as
unsupported and by the parser as malformed; mixing text with child elements,
invalid numbers and excessive nesting abort with typed diagnostics.

## Export

Export streams with `XmlWriter` (indented, LF newlines, UTF-8 without BOM; rows
buffered once to compute folder/file counts). `REPORT Title` comes from the request
or file name. `NAME`/`SIZE`/`DATE`/`TIME`/`TYPE`/`DESC` are written when present;
`FILES`/`FOLDERS` count direct children of container items. Descriptions use CDATA
split across adjacent sections around embedded `]]>` markers; everything else is
XML-escaped. Unknown extension properties round-trip back to elements/attributes.
Progress reports per top-level item; cancellation is honored per row.

## Tests

`tests/SkyCD.Plugin.DiskExplorer.Tests` covers complete/minimal/unknown-metadata
fixtures, Unicode, >4 GiB sizes, empty descriptions, DTD rejection (gate and
parser), invalid numbers, deep nesting, empty and wrong-root reports, detection
(including position preservation), exact round trips, escaping/CDATA splitting, and
cancellation of large imports.
